out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF COOK/WOK LINE being used TO STORE UTENSILS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE USED AND ACCESSIBLE FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: ALL handwashing sink is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet MEASURED MAXIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE OF 68F. PIC INDICATED WATER HEATER WAS NON FUNCTIONAL AND REPAIRED WAS SCHEDULED FOR TODAY.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE WATER TEMPERATURE OF MINIMUM OF 100F IS AVAILABLE AT HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW FISH STORED ABOVE COOKED CHICKEN AND RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE VEGETABLES IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: HOT SOUR SOUP AT 113F AND EGG DROP SOUP AT 112F ON CART IN FRONT SERVICE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TPHC PROCEDURES AND PLACE 4 HOUR TIME LABELS TO DISCARD UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS AT 5:40 PM.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: GARLIC IN OIL AT 59F AND POOLED EGGS AT 56F IN ICE BATHS ON CART NEAR WOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING AND REPLENISH ICE BATH TO ENSURE FOODS ARE MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): HOT SOUR SOUP, EGG DROP SOUP.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC APPLIED 4 HOUR TIME LABELS DURING INSPECTION. EHS WILL UPDATE TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO INCLUDE SOUPS. PLEASE ENSURE PROPER PROCEDURES ARE MAINTAINED FOR FOODS USING TPHC.

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: SHREDDED CABBAGE AND CUT NAPA CABBAGE.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY APPROPRIATE 4 HOUR TIME LABELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE UNUSED OR UNSOLD PORTIONS ARE DISCARDED AT 6:00 PM.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BEVERAGES AND SAUCES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE. FLOOR. CHENGS ASIAN HOUSE (Inspection Date: 05/07/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: INUSE UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 71F ON CART AT END OF WOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PIC REPLACED UTENSILS IN CLEAN DRY CONTAINER.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer ICE CREAM containers were observed reused for the storage of PREPARED VEGETABLES IN ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE REMOVE FOODS AND USE ONLY NSF APPROVED CONTAINERS WHICH CAN TOLERATE FREQUENT CLEANING AND SANITIZING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): STORAGE OF BEVERAGES AND EQUIPMENT IN FRONT SERVICE AREA AND KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS FOR STORAGE OF FOODS, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED MAXIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE OF 68F AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE MINIMUM WATER TEMPERATURE OF 110F IS AVAILABLE AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK .

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: REFRIGERATION UNITS, COOK LINE EQUIPMENT, CART NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. OBSERVED SEVERAL IN USE BEVERAGE CONTAINERS WITHOUT LIDS OVER COUNTER IN KITCHEN NEAR 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO HAVE EMPLOYEES PLACE LIDS AND STRAWS ON OPEN BEVERAGE CONTAINERS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE DESIGNATE AREA AWAY FROM FOOD PREPARATION AREA FOR STORAGE OF EMPLOYEE BEVERAGES.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE RINSE AND DRY HANDS WITHOUT USE OF SOAP.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE ON PROPER PROCEDURE FOR HAND WASHING WITH USE OF SOAP BEFORE RINSING AND DRYING HANDS WITH PAPER TOWELS. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in THE FOOD PREPARATION SINK.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO WASH HANDS AT HANDWASHING SINK ONLY WITH SOAP. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW FISH STORED OVER PREPARED CARROTS AND CABBAGE IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED INNER SURFACES OF ICE MACHINE WITH ACCUMULATION OF BLACK SUBSTANCES.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND SANITIZE SURFACES, IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: GARLIC IN OIL AT 55F, POOLED EGGS AT 61F IN ICE BATH ON CART NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REPLENISHED ICE BATH DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE TCS FOODS FOR COLD HOLDING ARE MAINTAINED AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: BEEF NOODLE SOUP AND COOKED PORK PREPARED FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITHOUT DATE MARKING IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOODS PREPARED AND HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS ARE DATE MARKED WITH THE DATE OF PREPARATION AND UNUSED PORTIONS DISCARDED AFTER 7 DAYS.

violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: SPINACH, SHREDDED CABBAGE AND CUT CABBAGE OVER SATURN 3 DOOR PREP TOP WITHOUT TIME DOCUMENTED.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: SEVERAL WOKING CONTAINERS OF SALT, SPICES, SUGAR, SAUCES AND OILS ON CART NEAR COOK LINE WITHOUT APPROPRIATE LABELING.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE LABELS FOR ALL FOODS REMOVED FROM ORIGINAL PACKAGING. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.
